test_is_accepted_host_loopback: test the _is_accepted_host function accepts loopback names when bound to 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1
test_is_accepted_host_rejects_attacker: test the _is_accepted_host function rejects attacker-controlled hostnames that TTL-flip to loopback addresses
test_is_accepted_host_zero_bind: test the _is_accepted_host function accepts any host when bound to 0.0.0.0
test_is_accepted_host_exact_match: test the _is_accepted_host function requires exact hostname match for non-loopback binds
test_middleware_rebinding_rejected: test the FastAPI host header middleware rejects requests with attacker Host headers via 400 response
